d.ko: The Rails are Yours in Train Sim World 5! Take on new challenges and new roles as you master the tracks and trains of iconic cities across 3 new routes. Immerse yourself in the ultimate rail hobby and embark on your next journey.
d.en: The Rails are Yours in Train Sim World 5! Take on new challenges and new roles as you master the tracks and trains of iconic cities across 3 new routes. Immerse yourself in the ultimate rail hobby and embark on your next journey.
d.zh: 来《模拟火车世界5》里，全世界的铁路尽属于你！在标志性的特色城市中，驾驶列车穿越铁轨，飞驰在 3 条全新线路上，用新的角色迎接新的挑战。你将沉醉于终极的铁路爱好中，开启你的下一段旅程。
